title: Request
description: A request the dashboard root sends to the product's API: an own binding's request, or a named shared request of the dashboard.

path.description: An absolute same-origin path: a single leading slash not followed by a slash or a backslash, with no control characters; the query string is part of the path. The root resolves it against the page origin and rejects any other origin before sending.

body.description: JSON body, allowed only with POST.

variables.description: Optional variables this request depends on: each key is a query key (GET) or a top-level body field (POST), each value the name of a variable whose value the host gives through the root's variables input. The root adds the host's value under that key before it sends the request, and re-runs the request when the value changes. A key already present in the path's query or in the body, a variable the host gives no value for, and a value that is not a string, a finite number or a boolean fail the cell.
